front: When did the USA declare war on Germany?
When did the German Spring Offensive begin?
What happened at Amiens on 8 August 1918?
back: A combined Allied attack with tanks broke German lines: the start of the Hundred Days.

front: When was the Kaiser's abdication announced?
back: 9 November 1918; a republic was proclaimed and Wilhelm II fled to the Netherlands.

front: When and where was the Armistice signed?
back: Early on 11 November 1918 at Compiègne; fighting stopped at 11 a.m.

front: Why did the Spring Offensive fail?
back: Supplies could not keep up, elite troops were lost, there was no clear objective, and Foch's unified command and American troops strengthened the Allies.
Fresh troops, food, materials and loans gave the Allies growing strength, and the prospect of them forced Germany's 1918 gamble.
